goal: Get the unit to 120 % of today's throughput (3,000 short t/d of salt instead of 2,500). If a check cannot pass without data the tool does not have, say UNSOLVABLE: and name the data.

result.headline: UNSOLVABLE: vendor compressor curve still missing

needs_human: E-201 clean heat-transfer coefficient actually achieved (U): If clean U < ~2,230 W/m²K, 11,000 m² is still too small at 120% and a second heater extension or higher circulation is needed
P-201 circulation flow and E-201 brine rise at 120%: If flow cannot keep DT ≤3 K, P-201 is an additional limit needing pump upgrade; correlation shows 58,514 m³/h needed for 3 K vs 15,000 m³/h rating
Purge disposal permit and V-301 concentration limit: If minimum purge evaporation is enforced, the split-trim is not allowed and E-301 needs enlargement from 900 to ~1,500 m² plus larger K-202
K-201 nameplate suction capacity and curve vs 226,800 kg/h: If real capacity <226.8 t/h, K-202 must take >25% and rating grows; if >226.8 t/h the split can be 80/20
Vendor compressor map, surge line and anti-surge valve capacity for K-202: Selection cannot be finalised and surge/start-up checks cannot pass without this; determines driver size and recycle
Cable catalogue ampacity for 185 mm² and TX-1 7.5 MVA rating: If ampacity lower, cable must go to 240-400 mm² or load centre moved; provisional 90.3% loading becomes over-limit
K-202 start-up dynamics and anti-surge control tuning: Without measured dynamics the pre-FEED dynamics gate stays not-run and commissioning tests stay open
